hecUrl.description:
Splunk HEC URL, e.g. https://stack.splunkcloud.com:8088 or
https://http-inputs-<stack>.splunkcloud.com:443. Must use https,
except http://localhost:* / http://127.0.0.1:* permitted for dev.

index.description: Optional. If empty, the HEC token's default index is used.

source.description: Optional. If empty, the HEC token's default source is used.

token.description:
HEC token. Returned masked ('***') on GET. PUT with the masked literal
'***' preserves the existing encrypted value; PUT with any other value
re-encrypts and replaces.
